summary: Allocates a new keyframe array and deep-copies every element from a source described by a2 (pointer at a2[0], count at a2[1]). Proceeds only when the source pointer is non-null and the count is at least 4. Calls UtilityFunction_8020, stores the count into this[1], allocates 28*count + 4 bytes through OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, stores the count in the header word and the payload pointer (header + 4) into this[0]. Then loops v3 over the count, resolving each source element through StridedArrayElementPointer (handles a source stride other than 28) and copying all 7 fields (dwords at +0,+4,+8,+12,+16,+20 and a float at +24) into the new buffer. Finally calls sub_457EE0 to recompute cumulative arc lengths. Returns this.

local_names.this: keyframe-array holder: pointer at this[0], count at this[4]
local_names.a2: source descriptor: array pointer at a2[0], element count at a2[1]
local_names.v2: alias of the source descriptor a2
local_names.v5: source element count read at a2[1], must be at least 4
local_names.v6: allocation result; header word receives the count
local_names.v8: source element pointer returned by StridedArrayElementPointer
local_names.v9: destination element pointer in the new buffer

operations.description: When the source array pointer a2[0] is null the whole operation is skipped
v5 = a2[1] reads the source element count; allocation and copy proceed only when v5 is at least 4
UtilityFunction_8020(this) is invoked before the allocation
this[1] = v5 stores the source count into the destination holder

OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(28 * v5 + 4) allocates 4 header bytes plus 28 bytes per element; on success the header word *v6 receives the count and the payload v7 = v6 + 1 (else v7 = 0) is stored into this[0]

For each index v3 below v5: StridedArrayElementPointer(v2, v3) resolves the source element pointer, and all 7 fields are copied into the new buffer at v9 = v11 + this[0] (dwords at +0,+4,+8,+12,+16,+20 and a float at +24); v3 increments and v11 advances by 28 per element
sub_457EE0((float *)this) recomputes the cumulative arc lengths over the freshly copied keyframe array
